# `pcm` tools

2 tools in the `pcm` operation domain. This reference covers every tool the server registers, including the ones a default deployment does not expose. See the [tool reference index](index.md) for every domain.

| Tool | Effect | Operation | Target | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hmc_get_pcm_preferences` | `read` | `pcm.get_preferences` | `metric_resource` | Get managed-system PCM monitoring preferences. |
| `hmc_set_pcm_preferences` | `mutate` | `pcm.set_preferences` | `metric_resource` | Enable/disable managed-system PCM data collection. |
